legend: Loosely cohesive and single dispersed round and spindle cells showing nuclear pleomorphism and in some cells eccentric cytoplasm. Chromatin smearing is present (Giemsa).

Large cells are round to spindle, with abundant eccentric cytoplasm, indicative of rhabdomyoblastic differentiation, and round, ovoid, or irregular nuclei with granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Plentiful stripped nuclei are present (Giemsa).

Single or loosely cohesive minute tissue fragments consisting of round cells with a high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm, with round and often pleomorphic nuclei with granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Occasional cells have more abundant, often eccentric cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and single necrotic cells are present (Giemsa).

Highly cellular tumour with largely single dispersed cells, which are predominantly round with scant cytoplasm and round, ovoid, or more pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei with granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Mitotic figures and single necrotic cells are present (Giemsa).

Large round cells with pleomorphic nuclei showing marked variation in size and granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Very occasional cells show rhabdomyoblastic differentiation with more abundant eccentric cytoplasm (Giemsa).
